Name: Update Alert Status
Author: Admin
Description: Update status of the alert in Microsoft Azure Security Center.

Parameters.Description: Specify the ID of the subscription for which you want to query information. Note: if subscription ID is provided at the integration level and action level, priority will be given to action configuration.
Specify an ID of the alert, where you want to update status.
Specify the location of the alert. Example: centralus.
Specify the status for the alert.
